phases.name: Consistency
phases.goal: Kill the variance. Build the strength base.

weeks.note: Baseline week. Strength starts. Order bloodwork.

ov.4: Easy run + Strength B — order lab panel this week

weeks.note: Introduce cadence drills.

ov.3: Easy run + cadence drills (4×3 min at +8 spm, 4×3 min at −5)

weeks.note: First full three-shoe rotation week. Different model each run.
Down week. Full rest Monday and Friday.
First real tempo session.

ov.2: Quality — 3×10 min steady-state, 2 min float between

weeks.note: Long run on pre-fatigued legs.
Run/walk 9:1 begins on every long run. Set the COROS interval timer.

ov.5: Long run 20 — run/walk 9:1 from minute one

weeks.note: Gut training starts. Fuel from minute 30, every long run.

ov.5: Long run 22 — fuel from min 30, target 60 g carb/hr

weeks.note: Down week.
First true back-to-back weekend.

ov.6: Back-to-back 12 — on unrecovered legs. Should feel bad.

weeks.note: Push fueling rate.

ov.5: Long run 24 — push to 70 g carb/hr

weeks.note: First circadian-trough session. Normal sleep, early alarm.

ov.5: Long run 26 — 3:30 AM start. Sleep normally, nap after.

weeks.note: Down week. Honest niggle audit — anything nagging?
Full race kit dress rehearsal.

ov.5: Long run 24 — full race kit. Pack, shoes, socks, everything.

weeks.note: Night running in the kit you'll actually wear in January.

ov.5: Long run 26 — night run, full cold-weather kit, two headlamps

weeks.note: Taper into the tune-up race.
Oakwood 24, Raleigh. Looped, flat, timed — a scale model of race day.

ov.5: OAKWOOD 24 — run 50 miles at 100-mile effort, then stop.

weeks.note: Recovery week. Tart cherry juice this week only.
Second circadian-trough session. Apply what the tune-up taught you.

ov.5: Long run 26 — 3:30 AM start. Normal sleep, nap after.

weeks.note: PEAK WEEK. Simulation 1.

ov.5: SIM 1 — 11–12 hrs, 12:00 PM start. Mirrors race laps 1–5.

weeks.note: Simulation 2 — back-to-back. Final hard block.

ov.6: SIM 2b — 3.5 hrs, 5:00 AM start on wrecked legs

weeks.note: Taper begins. Nothing over 3 hours from here on.
Drop bag list finalized. Crew briefed. Last strength session Dec 31.
Caffeine taper starts Jan 5 (cut 50%). Bank sleep over training.
Race week. Nothing new. Not one thing.

ov.1: Easy 5 with 6×1 min at race pace
ov.3: Full rest. Zero caffeine from Jan 10.

2026-07-27.note: Rest day — completed. Block officially underway.
